leadText: Chieko Honda (Japanese: 本多知恵子 Honda Chieko) was a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Chieko Honda (Japanese: 本多知恵子 Honda Chieko) was a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Honda was born on March 28, 1963, in , . She became a voice actress as an adult and led a long voice acting career since the mid-1980s. She provided the voice of Eterna City Gym Leader Gardenia during of the . At various points in her career, Honda was affiliated with the , Mix Max, and . On February 18, 2013, she passed away while undergoing treatment for multiple forms of colon cancer.
